stem: A control program reduces pest counts briefly but pressure rebounds repeatedly. What is the strongest IPM response?
choices: Reassess prevention, sanitation, environment, monitoring, timing and legally permitted control integration rather than repeating one tactic unchanged
Increase the same control indefinitely without measuring outcomes
Assume rebound proves all biological controls are ineffective
rationale: Recurring pressure calls for evaluation of the whole IPM system, including prevention, environment, sanitation, monitoring and compatible controls, with outcomes measured over time.
